$comment: Contract for the RegradeCase server-side command (AD-003, OD-007/AD-031, command-concurrency skill). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_RegradeCase). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_RegradeCase
customApi.description: T&C Manager reopens, overrides or regrades a graded outcome by setting the final outcome with a mandatory reason (OD-007, AD-031). The initial outcome is preserved so both survive (BR-007). Enforces optimistic concurrency and idempotency, and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_outcome to regrade.

requestParameters.name: FinalOutcome
requestParameters.description: The corrected final outcome: Pass, Pass with issues, Insufficient evidence or Potential harm.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Mandatory reason for the regrade, recorded on the outcome and the Audit Event (BR-012, NFR-AUD-01).

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version of the outcome, for optimistic concurrency. Omit to skip the check.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same regrade.

responseProperties.name: OutcomeId
responseProperties.description: Id of the al_outcome record that was regraded.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for an optimistic-concurrency conflict.
